question: Which union territory has the highest sex ratio value according to the 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puducherry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **2011 census data, Puducherry** boasts the **highest sex ratio **among all union territories, with **1037 females for every 1000 males.**
 
• Following closely behind are** Lakshadweep (946), Andaman and Nicobar Islands (878), Kashmir (883), and Sikkim (889), **which also exhibit relatively high sex ratios.
 
• Conversely, the union territories with the **lowest sex ratios **include **Daman and Diu (618), Dadra and Nagar Haveli (775), and Chandigarh (818).**
 
• The sex ratio serves as a crucial demographic indicator, representing the proportion of females to every 1000 males within a population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The 2011 Indian census**, also known as the **15th Indian census,** was carried out in two distinct phases: the house listing phase and the population enumeration phase.
 
• Commencing on 1 April 2010, the house listing phase entailed the comprehensive collection of data pertaining to all buildings across the nation.
 
• Additionally, this phase included the gathering of information for the National Population Register (NPR), intended for the issuance of a 12-digit unique identification number to every registered Indian resident by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI).
 
• Subsequently, the population enumeration phase took place between 9 and 28 February 2011, during which demographic data of the populace was meticulously recorded.
